#### Training the MLP on the digits

Train the [MLP](#def-feedforward-network) of @exm-feedforward-network on the `r format(py$n_train, big.mark = ",")` training images,
with `nn.CrossEntropyLoss`,
taking 500 steps of `torch.optim.SGD` with a learning rate of 0.5,
each on the whole [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set).
What fraction of the test images does it classify correctly?
